children: In November 2027, KAITO is scheduled to unlock up to 17.6 million tokens. That amount equals 7.29% of circulating supply. The tokens are set aside for several groups and uses: the community, the ecosystem, the foundation, investors, liquidity and the team.
Once the tokens are unlocked, recipients can choose to sell some of them. Sales from those allocations would add selling pressure on KAITO.

title: KAITO: Token unlock releases up to 17.6 million tokens - Nov 2027
